title: Extension Committee Standard: Measuring a Further Extension from the Request's Supporting Document in Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases
content:
**Which request.** For a further extension on a Cedarline Summit loan's Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case, the extension request the grant rests on is the most recently received extension request on the case that is still awaiting a decision. Among requests received on the same day, it is the one recorded later by its recorded date and time.

**Rule.** The measured extension is set by that request's supporting document:

1. **Financing commitment, with issued payoff terms.** Where the document is a financing commitment and the loan has a payoff case (its Payoff and Loan Satisfaction record) whose terms are issued with a statement good-through date, the measured extension runs from the current resolution deadline to 10 calendar days after that good-through date. This covers the scheduled closing plus time for the payoff funds to post.
2. **Financing commitment, no statement.** Where the document is a financing commitment and no such statement is on the payoff file, the measured extension runs from the current resolution deadline to 60 calendar days after the commitment date.
3. **Listing agreement.** The measured extension is the plan's extension days.

## Worked figures (hypothetical; current resolution deadline 1 December)

| Supporting document | Payoff file | Measured extension |
|---|---|---|
| financing commitment dated 15 November | terms issued, good through 5 January | to 15 January: 45 days |
| financing commitment dated 15 November | no issued statement | to 14 January: 44 days |
| financing commitment dated 15 September | no issued statement | to 14 November, before the deadline: minus 17 days |
| listing agreement | any | the plan's extension days |
